title: Preserve Help share cards when page metadata replaces the parent block
detail: Live /help and /help/changelog return no og:image while their inherited Twitter Help image still exists. Each page replaces openGraph with page copy but does not carry the parent file-convention images; the category template uses the same pattern. Resolve parent metadata and retain its exact image descriptors/URLs, with the existing static brand image as a fallback, and give Twitter the page-specific copy. Keep per-article file cards untouched. Local implementation passes 24 tests in four Help/schema/raster suites, actual metadata-export probes for all three callers, SEO guard and lint. Four synthetic regressions must fail. Pending full Next compile and whole-tree typecheck before closure. Production remains unchanged.

verify.evidence: Open pending compile/typecheck of the parent-resolution metadata exports. Actual three exports and helper fallback/override behavior pass local fixture checks; pre-repair live HTML records missing Help/changelog OG images. Close only after required local gates and the direct consequence probe pass; release verification remains separate.
